title: Salvage Title Transfer & Customer Buyout Rights
citation: UAE Unified Motor Vehicle Insurance Policy (CBUAE Standard), Chapter 1, Section 2, Article 9 (Salvage Settlement)
text: Upon total loss classification and settlement payment, full vehicle wreck ownership and salvage title transfer to the Insurer. If the policyholder requests to retain the damaged vehicle salvage (subject to insurer consent and non-structural scrap classification), the certified residual salvage valuation shall be deducted from the gross settlement sum payable to the insured.
